newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - JP MORGAN, OTHER INVESTORS VISIT THIS WEEK.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - JP MORGAN, OTHER INVESTORS VISIT THIS WEEK.

text.p: JP Morgan Securities and several other international finanical institutions will visit Lithuania this week to examine investment possibilities, the country's finance ministry said on Monday.
The ministry said in a statement that the international investors would arrive on Tuesday with the Lithuanian delegation which attended the annual EBRD conference in London.
It declined to name the other institutions coming with JP Morgan.
"This visit...will stimualte investor interest in the Lithuanian economy, government Treasury bill market and Eurobonds," the statement said.
JP Morgan has been named as the lead bank for the country's upcoming $200 million Eurobond issue.
The bond will be issued after the country acquires a rating from rating agency Standard & Poors.
